reason: Provides a DSH Web attachment dock that collects files, stores them on the Host, and delivers local path references to the Agent without parsing file contents.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供统一附件栏，用于接收文件、保存到主机并将本地路径引用交给智能体。
summaries.en: Adds a unified DSH Web attachment dock that receives files, stores them on the Host, and passes local path references to the Agent.

capabilities: accepts pasted, dropped, selected, and clipboard-referenced files
saves uploaded attachments on the local DSH Host filesystem
creates path references for Agent use
can open local files with the system application
